items.title: Multiple people feared dead in collapsed shopping mall following Japan quake
items.description: Japan's south-western Kyushu island has been struck by two strong earthquakes within an hour,, with multiple people presumed dead after an explosion at a shopping centre.

items.title: Home loan borrowers missing out on millions in offset savings
items.description: The corporate regulator found Australian banks paid more than $55 million in compensation in just two years, for failures with mortgage offset accounts, warning customers could be paying more interest than they should.

items.title: Hanson reveals who paid for Italy trip with Gina Rinehart
items.description: The benefactor of Pauline Hanson's Italy trip has been disclosed in an update to the One Nation leader's gift registry.

items.title: Live: Double gymnastics gold on beam and bars, boxers guaranteed medals
items.description: It's day five of the Commonwealth Games and that means the fastest man and woman will be crowned in the 100m, the Diamonds take on Malawi and Kyle Chalmers goes for gold. Follow live.

items.title: Australia supplants China as Pacific's biggest lender
items.description: Australia supplants China as the dominant lender and infrastructure investor across the Pacific as the government ploughs billions of dollars into the region through both foreign aid and loans.

items.title: Marathon 24-hour Qantas flight tracked by 3.6 million internet users
items.description: The specially-modified aircraft will be one of 12 used by Qantas to fly between Australia's east coast and Europe.

items.title: Housing market eased 'more than anticipated', RBA says
items.description: The Reserve Bank governor says the world has become more shock-prone in recent years, and the latest oil spike is a complication for the central bank's monetary policy.

items.title: A rogue AI just gave us a warning. Australia isn't prepared
items.description: Far-fetched scenarios about artificial intelligence became more realistic last week when an OpenAI model hacked another company.

items.title: With a forceful declaration, Ben Carroll halted Jacinta Allan's agenda
items.description: Victoria's new premier, Ben Carroll has only four months to convince voters he could be the man for the top job, after the toppling of Jacinta Allan.

items.title: Former Melbourne organised crime kingpin sentenced to life in Iraq prison
items.description: Kazem Hamad, a former Melbourne organised crime kingpin who was deported to Iraq in 2023, has been sentenced to life in jail by an Iraqi court after being convicted of drug trafficking.

items.title: Origin Energy believes 900,000 customers' data accessed in breach
items.description: Origin Energy says it started reviewing a "potential security threat" early this month but deemed it not credible, before new information indicated a breach.

items.title: Australian-founded restaurant at centre of South Korean court case over ant garnish
items.description: Seoul prosecutors have alleged Evett in Seoul's Gangnam district served ants illegally imported from Thailand and the US in violation of food safety regulations.

items.title: Rabbi supports stopping hospital staff from wearing Israeli, Palestinian pins
items.description: Jewish patients requested their religion be removed from their hospital admission information following allegations nurses made menacing comments about Israeli patients, the royal commission on antisemitism has heard.

items.title: ICAC told of right-wing faction's plan to 'shake down Angus for 10k'
items.description: The NSW corruption watchdog has heard claims senior Liberal figures discussed seeking financial backing for the party's right-wing faction from now-federal Opposition Leader Angus Taylor.

items.title: 'Straight to the pool room': Film classic The Castle goes on stage
items.description: The feature film responsible for Australian sayings such as ''Tell him he's dreaming'' is being launched as a stage production.

items.title: Why I was a chronic people pleaser — and what worked instead
items.description: For me, people pleasing was a coping mechanism that developed over time out of vigilance, responsibility and love for my family. But there was a better way.

items.title: Struggling to save? Here are five ways to curb your impulse spending
items.description: If you'd rather be saving than shopping, but are struggling to switch gears, there are ways to change your habits.

items.title: Outcome of Hobart snack saga debate 'will be public', says councillor
items.description: Councillors at the City of Hobart say they are unable to share the outcome of a motion heard behind closed doors at last night's meeting, which called for an investigation into the conduct of the deputy lord mayor.

items.title: US pharma giant to pay out $7.9 billion over baby powder lawsuits
items.description: A US pharmaceutical company will pay $7.9 billion to settle thousands of lawsuits that claim its baby powder caused ovarian cancer.

items.title: Country footy player charged after 'ugly' scenes in southern WA
items.description: Police charge a Cowaramup man with assault and choking after a clash in WA's Lower South West Football League.

items.title: Inquiry finds 'systemic shortcomings' in Victoria's bushfire response
items.description: A Legislative Council Environment and Planning Committee report into the devastating 2026 Victorian bushfires has been tabled in parliament.

items.title: Ocean search for missing baby boy suspended because of rough weather
items.description: The search for a three-month-old baby boy still missing after the bodies of his mother and sister were recovered from waters off SA's South East has been suspended because of weather conditions, police say.

items.title: US and Iran in 'good talks' Trump says as support for war wanes
items.description: US President Donald Trump says the United States is having "good talks" with Iran, and there is a chance of a deal over their conflict, but he warns that US strikes will resume if the negotiations fail to deliver.

items.title: Joint spares Aussie blushes on tough day at Memphis Open
items.description: Rising star Maya Joint has spared Australia's blushes at the WTA's hard-court event in Memphis as her compatriots struggle.

items.title: Embattled MP Moira Deeming resigns from Victorian Liberal Party
items.description: Moira Deeming says she will remain in parliament as an independent, after having her candidacy revoked by the Liberal party earlier this month.
